title: Loch Maree Hotel

buildingCutout.basis: The early hotel’s estimated envelope is aligned to the standing mapped site.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the approximated southwest historic entrance. The foundation spans the loch-side grade.

identities.name: Loch Maree Hotel
identities.address: Loch Maree Hotel, Talladale, Achnasheen, Wester Ross, Scotland

mapIdentity.scope: The existing hotel is identified by its mapped name and distinct building entity. The nineteenth-century photograph-derived engraving constrains the original frontage and side proportions. Present outline is the positional tie.

note: The October 1877 issue of The Graphic shows the paired sash windows, recessed main entry, dormer, prominent gables, chimney stacks and southeast bay.
